```{r setup}
library(mypackage)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Summarising data

`summarise_by_group()` gives a quick descriptive summary by group:

```{r}
summarise_by_group(ToothGrowth, "len", "supp")
```

## Neudata-styled figures

Use `theme_neudata()` with `scale_colour_neudata()` or `scale_fill_neudata()`:

```{r}
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(factor(dose), len, fill = supp)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_neudata(name = "Supplement") +
  labs(x = "Dose (mg/day)", y = "Tooth length") +
  theme_neudata()
```
